reproduction: The capture module with this SHA-256, run with the base commit's microcosm/frame/transport.py and microcosm/build/transport/population_kernels.py in place of the edited ones, writes every file listed here byte for byte.
scope: Captured on the unedited base commit, before CREATE accepted a donor_profile. Each file holds the canonical bytes of transport.create's frame and receipt on its declared params and sources, for one toy donor or composed toy graph. Four files (toy, toy_profile_columns, composed and nz_toy) also hold the populace-us-h5-v1 codec's frame of the same donor. toy_v2 runs transport.create@2 on a donor written by the same call as toy's, and its codec field is null. No file holds real donor data.
